in_sanskrit.name: अरुण्यता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arunyata is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Arun, which means red or dawn. Arunyata can be interpreted as the 'darkness of Arun', representing the mysterious and hidden aspects of the divine being Arun.

in_hindi.name: अरुण्यता
in_hindi.long_meaning: Arunyata एक हिंदी नाम है जो 'अरुण' के साथ संबंधित है जिसमें 'संध्या' या 'सोम' के रूप दिवाकर सूर्य का रूप धरती है। अरुण्यता के नाम के अर्थ को गुठिया बताने से अरुण का दूरदश्त या अतिगणनात्मक स्वरूप को बताते जाते हैं।

in_tamil.name: அருண்யாதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Arunyata is a name that holds significance in Tamil as well. It can be translated to 'Arunudan', which is a Tamil name derived from Arun. Arunudan is a name that signifies the power and strength of Arun, the god of dawn.

in_telugu.name: అరుణ్యాద
in_telugu.long_meaning: Arunyata is also a name with significance in the Telugu language. It can be translated to 'Arunyaaada', which is a Telugu name derived from Arun. Arunyaaada signifies the one who is closely associated with Arun, the god of dawn.

in_marathi.name: Arunyata
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arunyata हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Arunyata is derived from Sanskrit. It is a compound name, composed of two words: Arun (red) and Yata (limit). The name Arunyata means 'Sun's Limit'. In Hindu mythology, Arun is the god of dawn and the commander of the army of the gods. His wife is the goddess of dawn, Prakriti. Together, they represent the beginning of a new day and the end of darkness. Arunyata is a name imbued with the power of the dawn and the promise of a new beginning.
